data.about: A hall roof hangs from a cable spanning from a low wall to a high one; the roof sheet rides on short posts standing on the cable, and six equal loads press down on it. The cable through the fixed midspan sag is found with the half-chord construction (parallels to the two chords through the ends of the load line meet at the pole o). At the left support the backstay and pylon forces are PRESCRIBED — 2074 and 1716 kN — and their directions, copied into the form, find the ground points; at the right support the anchors are draggable on the terraces and the forces follow. Reactions A, B, C, D close the force diagram around the load line.

steps.title: How to draw this scheme

steps.caption: left: a low wall on the left, a high wall on the right, terraced ground between and behind them — the roof must span 48 m (1 :: 400)
steps.title: The hall

steps.caption: left: the cable will hang from B₁₆ on the low wall to B₁₇ on the high wall; verticals mark the six node bays (4 + 5×8 + 4 m)

steps.caption: left: the cable must pass through A at midspan; F mirrors the chord midpoint through A, and B₁₆–F and F–B₁₇ are the chords of the two halves (the parabola construction)

steps.caption: left: the roof presses 6 × 264 kN onto the cable nodes — right: F₁ … F₆ stack down the load line from G (drag G)
steps.title: The loads and the load line

steps.caption: right: parallel to chord B₁₆–F through G, parallel to chord F–B₁₇ through g → pole o: every cable force will be a ray from o
steps.title: The pole o

steps.caption: right: rays o–G and o–b — left: parallel to o–G from B₁₆ to the first vertical → L₂, parallel to o–b on to L₃
steps.title: From the left — members 3 and 4

steps.caption: right: ray o–c — left: parallel on to L₄: the left half of the cable
steps.title: Member 5

steps.caption: right: rays o–g and o–f — left: parallel to o–g from B₁₇ to L₁, parallel to o–f on to L₆
steps.title: From the right — members 9 and 8

steps.caption: right: ray o–e — left: parallel on to L₅: the right half of the cable
steps.title: Member 7

steps.caption: right: ray o–d — left: the two chains meet in the middle piece L₄–L₅, and it passes exactly through the sag point A (light tangent line)

steps.caption: left: short posts carry the grey roof sheet — standing on the cable in the middle (compression), hanging under it at the ends (tension)

steps.caption: right: backstay force A = 2074 kN and pylon force B = 1716 kN are chosen: circles from G and o meet at j — left: copying directions j–G and j–o through B₁₆ finds the ground anchor D and the pylon foot B₂
steps.title: Left support — members 1 and 2, forces PRESCRIBED

steps.caption: left: the anchors E₂ and E₄ are picked on the terraces (drag them!) — right: parallels through g and o meet at i₇: forces C and D follow from the geometry
steps.title: Right support — members 10 and 11, geometry chosen

steps.caption: right: the four outer edges G–j, j–o, o–i₇, i₇–g of the closed diagram are the support forces, read beside them (dotted offsets) — left: green arrows at the anchor D, the feet B₂ and E₂, and the anchor E₄
steps.title: The reactions A, B, C, D

steps.caption: cable, backstays and end posts resolve pink = tension, pylons and middle posts blue = compression (pipes ∝ force) — drag E₂, E₄ or G; click a node for its equilibrium
